title: Copper short feathered shag
caption: Notice the lifted crown, wispy fringe, airy face-framing layers, and softly feathered pieces around the ears and nape.
patternDescription: Loose natural movement gives the short layers separation while the ends feather outward rather than collapsing into a solid perimeter.
lengthDescription: The cut sits around ear-to-nape length, with shorter crown and fringe layers and slightly longer pieces retained around the sides and back.
